Skills.Name: Hydromancy
Skills.Description: Water mastery. Your soakings run 0.25 deeper, so targets stay above the thresholds that matter: 0.2 for lightning's doubled charge, 0.35 for shrugging off fire. Water deals almost no damage — it makes everything else lethal.

Powers.Name: Jet Blast
Powers.Description: Cone 2: soaks and shoves. Sets up lightning.

Powers.Name: Drench Lob
Powers.Description: Range 6, bursts radius 2. Soaks a clump early.

Powers.Name: Undertow
Powers.Description: Line 3: soaks and DRAGS them toward you.
